human_labels.judge_rationale: The proposed edit is narrow, directive, and makes completion observable, and the artifact correctly requires fresh blind reruns of all three cases with separate judges. However, its reporting requirement specifies only a general before/after pass rate, not the required per-case pass rates, so not every criterion passes.

observations.value:
Replace the vague completion rule with:

> “Do not stop at ‘make it good’ or any equivalent subjective standard. Define an observable, case-specific completion bar: what the finished artifact must achieve and which smells would make it unacceptable. Keep this outcome-oriented rather than prescribing an exhaustive parts checklist. Continue until the artifact clears that bar; if the bar cannot be resolved, request it instead of declaring completion.”

Then re-run all three golden cases to check both the fix and regressions:

- Use one fresh, context-free runner per case with only the revised skill and case input; never expose the bar or expected outcome.
- Use separate judges who receive the artifact, the case’s bar, and the skill’s first principles.
- Grade each artifact directly against its bar, citing any concrete gap rather than assigning an opaque numeric score.
- Inspect the live checkout after every run and remove any leaked state.
- Report the original failure, its mapping to the vague completion criterion, the revision, and the before/after pass rate.
